title: Lock-in as a decision, not an accident

videos.script: People say lock-in the way they say debt. As if it were always a mistake. {{kinds}} This lesson takes it apart. There are five kinds, and only one of them has an end date. Each is bought with something you wanted, and each compute choice in this course carries a different mix. {{seam}} Then the seam this course has leaned on since lesson 7. One image of the shop, run three ways on your laptop. On its own, beside a Dapr sidecar, and as a pod in kind. You will check its digest each time, and it will not move. {{cost}} Next, what leaving would cost. A short program scores every part of the shop in person-days, then adds the data and the months of running both. The numbers are invented. The biggest line is rarely the one people expect. {{record}} And last, a decision record. The lock-in the shop accepts, a way out of each part, and the facts that would make it think again.
